categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a real estate investment trust (REIT) focusing on real estate leasing. Its main business involves acquiring, managing, improving, and disposing of real estate properties, including commercial facilities and office buildings, and distributing rental income and dividends to shareholders.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: As a REIT, the company does not engage in manufacturing or technology development. Its core methods involve real estate asset acquisition, management, leasing, and financial asset management under the Real Estate Investment Company Act, with asset management outsourced to specialized asset management firms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are commercial tenants such as GS Retail (with Lotte Shopping as the sub-lessee) occupying the company's commercial facilities. The company serves the real estate leasing market, targeting retail and office space tenants in South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea, with key properties located in major urban areas such as Suwon (Gwanggyo Central Prugio City commercial facility), Gangnam (KG Tower), and Seocho (Majesta City Tower 1) in Seoul.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the real estate investment supply chain as a REIT, focusing on property ownership, leasing, and asset management rather than property development or construction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding its portfolio of high-quality real estate assets to generate stable rental income and dividends. It pursues proactive capital raising through equity and debt instruments to acquire premium assets and enhance shareholder value, with no direct R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through rental income from leased investment properties. The company also earns dividend income from equity investments in other real estate investment companies and investment trusts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes within the Korean REIT market, which includes 23 listed REITs with total assets of approximately 16 trillion KRW. It positions itself as a publicly listed, asset-focused REIT with a portfolio of commercial and office properties, competing for institutional and retail investor capital.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of May 2024, the company has total assets of approximately 304 billion KRW and equity of about 103 billion KRW. It has shown capital increases through multiple equity issuances since its 2019 establishment and 2020 listing, with recent revenue around 6.55 billion KRW for the latest half-year period, reflecting a decrease compared to the previous period.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers investors access to stable, income-generating real estate assets through a publicly traded REIT structure. Its portfolio includes prime commercial facilities with high occupancy rates (100% occupancy at key properties), providing predictable rental income and dividend distributions, supported by professional asset management partnerships.
